maddeler.e:
ابتكرن (form VIII)
# اِبْتَكَرْنَ (ibtakarna) /ib.ta.kar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِبْتَكَرَ (ibtakara)
# اُبْتُكِرْنَ (ubtukirna) /ub.tu.kir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِبْتَكَرَ (ibtakara)
# اِبْتَكِرْنَ (ibtakirna) /ib.ta.kir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِبْتَكَرَ (ibtakara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
